youtube_title: Bachelor's Grove: the cemetery in the woods outside Chicago
body: Deep in the woods outside Chicago, near Midlothian, there's a cemetery the road forgot. Settlers were burying their dead at Bachelor's Grove by the 1840s, and some say earlier. In the 1960s the road beside it closed, and vandals came, toppling and stealing headstones. And the stories spread: lights drifting between the graves, a farmhouse that appears, then fades away. In 1991, a ghost hunter's infrared photo seemed to show a woman in an old-fashioned dress, sitting alone on a tombstone. Most of the gravestones are gone now. The stories never stopped. It's surrounded by the Rubio Woods forest preserve, open sunrise to sunset. Don't be there after dark. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #BachelorsGrove #Chicago #Midlothian #Illinois #Haunted #LaPorteAfterDark
